title: Smoky Thai Hash
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish made with smoky sausage, potatoes, and peruvian peppers.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the smoky sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the peruvian peppers and cook for an additional minute.
If using noxious peppers, add them now and stir to combine.
Use a spatula to create hash marks in the pan, allowing excess moisture to escape.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a spatula to break up the hash into small pieces, creating a crispy crust.
Serve hot, garnished with additional peruvian peppers if desired.
